messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — we're onboarding a new org (acme-ai) across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Need a concise provisioning checklist + quota playbook. Primary asks: GPUs (A100/H100 where available), ENI/networking limits, regional IPs, and any service quota gotchas for us-west / eu / apac.

Priya: Good call. High-level checklist: 1) create org + billing account, 2) create folders/projects per environment (prod/staging/dev) and apply tags, 3) service accounts + least-priv IAM roles, 4) request quota increases with support (attach justification), 5) reserve capacity if serving low-latency workloads, 6) add monitoring + cost tags. Internal runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/cloud-account-provisioning :white_check_mark:

Jorge: GPU specifics from infra side: request quotas by GPU SKU and by region. For initial commit propose: A100: 32 GPUs regionally, H100: 8 GPUs regionally (request depends on availability). On AWS ask for p4/p5 quota; on GCP request A100 quota in europe-west1/us-west2/ap-northeast1. Also request ENI / network interfaces bump (example: 2k per account) and ephemeral port SNAT increases for Cloud NAT if hitting 65k limits.

Emily: Also include pricing ops note: if workloads are bursty use spot/preemptible for training. For serving, recommend dedicated reserved capacity or committed use discounts — include expected hours to justify.

Nate: To make quota tickets fast, open one support case per cloud + one per region if vendor requires it. Include this template in the request: 
Subject: "Quota increase request for acme-ai — GPUs + networking (region)"
Body: "Customer: acme-ai, Use case: low-latency inference + batch training, Expected concurrency: X requests/s, Expected GPU hours/month: Y, Preferred SKUs: A100/H100, Requested total GPUs: N, Desired start date: YYYY-MM-DD, Cost center: CC-1234, Runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/cloud-account-provisioning"

Alex: Can we paste a short `gcloud`/`aws` example for the ticket? Saves time.

Jorge: Sure — sample GCP check command (very quick):
```
# List region quotas
gcloud compute regions describe us-west2 --format="table(quotas.metric,quotas.limit,quotas.usage)"
```
For AWS, include console screenshots of EC2 limits + requested vCPU/GPU numbers.

Priya: IAM + tags rules: enforce folder-level tags: `redwood:cost-center`, `redwood:env`, `redwood:owner`. Create SA per service with narrowly scoped roles. Add billing export and enable billing alerts before any big spin-ups.

Emily: For Azure, make sure to request quota for GPU VM SKUs and regional core quotas, and ask for accelerated networking enablement on the VM scale sets. Also double-check quotas for public IPs if you need many endpoints.

Nate: I'll open three baseline tickets after this thread: AWS Support, GCP Support, Azure Support. Will attach cost justification + expected throughput. ETA to have tickets submitted: EOD today.

InfraBot: Automated reminder — attach perf profile and sample load pattern when filing tickets. See: https://go.redwood/tools/quota-justification-template :robot_face:

Alex: Perfect. Next actions: Nate opens tickets + links them here. Jorge to draft exact SKU counts per region. Priya will prepare IAM + tag policy. Emily will add cost/discount guidance. I'll coordinate with customer success for their timelines. :thumbsup:

Jorge: Draft counts will be posted here in the next hour.

Nate: Tickets submitted: AWS-12345, GCP-67890, AZ-54321 — attaching them to the onboarding jira.

Alex: Thanks all — this helps. We'll run through the runbook during onboarding call tomorrow.
